pattern: に違いない（にちがいない）
purpose: Make a confident inference from available clues.
keywords: Plain form + に違いない; noun / な-adjective stem + に違いない
The light is on. Someone must be there.
After practicing every day, she is bound to improve.
These footprints must belong to a cat.
formation: Plain form + に違いない; noun / な-adjective stem + に違いない
restrictions: Expresses the speaker’s conviction, not independently verified truth.
mistake: Use はず for a reasoned expectation; に違いない stresses certainty of inference.
